change.mechanism: Launch an already-cached NextN graph asynchronously, record a private completion event, make the already-cached N2 stream wait, inject each proposal ID into both i64 embedding and i32 acceptance metadata columns, append proposal ID/value rows to the existing bounded N2 result payload, and let the target synchronization retire both submissions.
change.scheduler_contract: Plan with shape-only rows, reconstruct real draft rows from the bounded payload, rebind the unchanged transaction, and require the independent CPU acceptance oracle before commit.
change.fallbacks: Capture misses, diagnostic logits, caller streams, output-cap tails, long contexts, and unsupported shapes retain the independently synchronized exact route. No in-flight proposal triggers target capture or post-launch fallback.
